1.web: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
1.asv: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beseech you to walk worthily of the calling wherewith ye were called,

2.web: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love;
2.asv: with all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

3.web: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
3.asv: giving diligence to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

4.web: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling;
4.asv: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as also ye were called in one hope of your calling;

5.web: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
5.asv: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

6.web: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in us all.
6.asv: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in all.

7.web: But to each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
7.asv: But unto each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

8.web: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men.”
8.asv: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, And gave gifts unto men.

9.web: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?
9.asv: (Now this, He ascended, what is it but that he also descended into the lower parts of the earth?

10.web: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.
10.asv: He that descended is the same also that ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.)

11.web: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
11.asv: And he gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

12.web: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ;
12.asv: for the perfecting of the saints, unto the work of ministering, unto the building up of the body of Christ:

13.web: until we all attain to the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ;
13.asv: till we all attain unto the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a fullgrown man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

14.web: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
14.asv: that we may be no longer children, tossed to and fro and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

15.web: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, Christ;
15.asv: but speaking truth in love, may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, even Christ;

16.web: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
16.asv: from whom all the body fitly framed and knit together through that which every joint supplieth, according to the working in due measure of each several part, maketh the increase of the body unto the building up of itself in love.

17.web: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
17.asv: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye no longer walk as the Gentiles also walk, in the vanity of their mind,

18.web: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts;
18.asv: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their heart;

19.web: who having become callous gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
19.asv: who being past feeling gave themselves up to lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

20.web: But you did not learn Christ that way;
20.asv: But ye did not so learn Christ;

21.web: if indeed you heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
21.asv: if so be that ye heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

22.web: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man, that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit;
22.asv: that ye put away, as concerning your former manner of life, the old man, that waxeth corrupt after the lusts of deceit;

23.web: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
23.asv: and that ye be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

24.web: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
24.asv: and put on the new man, that after God hath been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

25.web: Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.
25.asv: Wherefore, putting away falsehood, speak ye truth each one with his neighbor: for we are members one of another.

26.web: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
26.asv: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

27.web: neither give place to the devil.
27.asv: neither give place to the devil.

28.web: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
28.asv: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing that is good, that he may have whereof to give to him that hath need.

29.web: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for building up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
29.asv: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for edifying as the need may be, that it may give grace to them that hear.

30.web: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
30.asv: And grieve not the Holy Spirit of God, in whom ye were sealed unto the day of redemption.

31.web: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander, be put away from you, with all malice.
31.asv: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamor, and railing, be put away from you, with all malice:

32.web: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
32.asv: and be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, even as God also in Christ forgave you.
